name: agents-shipgate
description: Review declared coding-agent configuration changes with Agents Shipgate; verify tool-using agent releases separately.

interface.shortDescription: Review declared host changes and agent releases.
interface.longDescription: Review PR changes to declared coding-agent permissions, MCP bindings, hooks and workflow permissions with agents-shipgate diff. This static host comparison needs no manifest, policy, saved baseline or skill; it names coverage limits and implies no verdict. Agents Shipgate teaches Codex how to detect, install, verify, and summarize deterministic Tool-Use Readiness release gates for tool-using AI agent repositories. The plugin supplies workflow instructions; the scanner runs through the agents-shipgate CLI installed in the local environment.
capabilities: Detect whether Shipgate applies to an agent repo
Triage findings without fabricating human approval
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agents-shipgate to add or verify a Tool-Use Readiness release gate for this agent repo.
